commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply any unapplied D1 migrations. Creates the bookkeeping table if absent, diffs the migration files under --dir against what the table records, and applies the rest in numeric order. Wire-compatible with `wrangler d1 migrations apply`: same table shape, same --dir-relative recorded names, same ordering. The database must be identified by ID; names and binding names are not accepted.

arguments.description: D1 database ID

options.name: dir
options.description: Directory containing migration files (default: ./migrations)

options.name: pattern
options.description: Glob for discovering migration files. Defaults to "<dir>/*.sql"; Drizzle's nested layout uses "<dir>/*/migration.sql"

options.name: table
options.description: Table recording applied migrations; must use Wrangler's bookkeeping schema (default: d1_migrations)

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Parse arguments and show the command without executing it

commands.name: create
commands.description: Register a domain. Billable and non-refundable — a successful registration charges the account's default payment method. Input fields are extension-specific: they come from `GET /registrar/extensions/{name}` at run time. Humans can run `create <domain> --help` and use prompts; reusable contacts can be passed as `--contacts @contacts.json`. Agents should call with `--dry-run --body '<json>'`: incomplete input returns structured `missingFields` with paths, choices, labels, and acknowledgement text without submitting. Retain the other input, collect the missing values, and repeat the dry run before checking availability and creating with explicit confirmation. Inspect unfinished workflows with `cf registrar registrations get-registration-status <domain>`.

arguments.name: domain-name
arguments.description: Fully qualified domain name to register, e.g. example.travel

options.name: extension
options.description: Extension whose registration schema to use (default: derived from the domain)

options.name: prefer
options.description: Set the Prefer header, e.g. `respond-async` to skip the synchronous wait

options.name: force
options.description: Skip the registration confirmation prompt

options.name: contacts
options.description: Registrant contacts as inline JSON or @path to a reusable JSON file. The JSON value is inserted as the request's `contacts` field, so the file has no outer `contacts` wrapper.

options.name: body
options.description: Raw JSON request body, or @path to a JSON file. Use instead of the per-extension fields. With `dry-run`, incomplete input returns structured `missingFields`; rerun with the completed body.

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Validate and show what would happen without executing

options.name: help
options.description: Show help, including this extension's input flags
